newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries slide as dollar falls, stocks drop.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries slide as dollar falls, stocks drop.

text.p: *US Treasuries slide as dollar falls on Buba rate hike fears.
*Lower dollar exacerbates pressure on Treasuries from profit-taking. Dow down 112 on Wall Street.
*No government economic data due. University of Michigan consumer sentiment report expected at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT.
